columns.J [A_per_m2]: PROXY: Im / conductor_area (area not in dataset)
columns.RPM [rpm]: DERIVED from time span and pole pairs
columns.L(Phase_x,Phase_y): DERIVED: incremental inductance dpsi_abc/di_abc per rotor sample, from finite differences of SOURCE psi_d, psi_q over the (Im, Gamma) grid; cross terms symmetrised; zero-sequence = 0. NOT Maxwell frozen-permeability values.
columns.FluxLinkage(Phase_x) [Wb]: RECONSTRUCTED: inverse Park of SOURCE psi_d, psi_q; zero-sequence = 0
columns.InducedVoltage(Phase_x) [uv]: DERIVED: periodic central difference of reconstructed phase flux
columns.InputCurrent(Phase_x) [mA]: RECONSTRUCTED: inverse Park of Id=-Im*sin(Gamma), Iq=Im*cos(Gamma)

notes: Source readme says one electrical rotation lasts 2.5 s, but the CSV time header is in ms (0-2.5 ms). The header is used by default (3000 rpm); use --time-unit s for the readme's value (3 rpm). Only RPM and InducedVoltage depend on this.
Gamma = -180 and +180 are the same physical operating point; Im = 0 is repeated for every Gamma. Both duplicates are kept, as in the source.
